title: Restriction of a quotient by an fppf relation is an open subspace
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U,R,U'$ be schemes over $S$, and let $j=(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be an equivalence relation: for every $S$-scheme $T$, $j$ identifies $R(T)$ with an equivalence relation on $U(T)$. Suppose $s,t:R\to U$ are surjective, flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $g:U'\to U$ be flat and locally of finite presentation, and let $R'=U'\times_{g,U,s}R\times_{t,U,g}U'$ be the restricted relation. On the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site], let $F=U/R$ and $F'=U'/R'$ be the sheafifications [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $T\mapsto U(T)/R(T)$ and $T\mapsto U'(T)/R'(T)$. The canonical map $F'\to F$ is representable and an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]: for every $S$-scheme $T$ and $a:h_T\to F$, the pullback $h_T\times_F F'$ is represented by an open subscheme of $T$.

source.place: Tag 02WU (finding-opens), using Tag 02VH for restriction of the relation and Tags 023Q/02W2 for fppf descent of opens

proof.text: For every $T$, a pair $(u'_1,u'_2)$ belongs to $R'(T)$ exactly when $(g u'_1,g u'_2)$ belongs to $R(T)$, by the fibre-product definition [def-pc-fibre-product]. Pullback of an equivalence relation along a function is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, and $R'(T)\to U'(T)^2$ is injective. Thus $R'$ is an equivalence relation, so both presheaf quotients in the statement are defined.

The map $F'\to F$ is injective. Indeed, locally on an fppf covering any two sections $b,c\in F'(V)$ lift to $u',v'\in U'(V)$, using [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] for the quotient presheaf, choosing representatives of its quotient classes. If their images in $F$ agree, [lem-trf-etale-relation-kernel-pair] gives a unique $r:V\to R$ with $s r=g u'$ and $t r=g v'$. Hence $(u',r,v')$ belongs to $R'(V)$, so $b=c$ locally and therefore globally by the sheaf condition. The kernel-pair node assumes only a monomorphic equivalence relation, not etaleness, and applies here.

Put $E=U'\times_{g,U,s}R$ and let $p:E\to U$ be $t$ after projection to $R$. That projection is the base change of $g$, hence flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change] and locally of finite presentation by clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence]. Composition with $t$ preserves these two properties by [lem-pc-flat-compose] and [lem-sbc-locally-finite-presentation-composition]. Thus $W=p(E)$ is open in $U$ by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open]. The map $p$ factors through this open as a surjection $\bar p:E\to W$. This factor is still flat and locally of finite presentation: its stalk maps are those of $p$, and an affine presentation $B=A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$ remains such a presentation over a smaller basic target open: $B_a=A_a[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(f_1,\ldots,f_m)$ [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. There is no assumption that $g$ is surjective onto $U$.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), open saturated image and the two successive covers in the displayed diagram, packaged as their composite

proof.text: Fix $v:V\to U$, and set $W_V=v^{-1}(W)$, with its open subscheme structure. The map $D=E\times_W W_V\to W_V$ is surjective by [lem-weil-pbc-surjective-base-change], flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change], and locally of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3). It is therefore a one-member fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site]. On $D$, the maps to $U'$ and $R$ supplied by $E$ show that the section of $F$ induced by $v$ is the image of a section of $F'$. On $D\times_{W_V}D$ these two sections of $F'$ agree, since their images in $F$ agree and step 2 proved injectivity. They glue uniquely, giving a morphism $h_{W_V}\to h_V\times_F F'$.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), proof that the candidate open maps to the restricted quotient

proof.text: Conversely, let $z:Z\to V$ and $b\in F'(Z)$ have the same image in $F(Z)$ as $v z$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local], on an fppf cover $\{Z_k\to Z\}$ the section $b$ is represented by $b_k:Z_k\to U'$. Equality in $F$ and [lem-trf-etale-relation-kernel-pair] give $r_k:Z_k\to R$ with $s r_k=g b_k$ and $t r_k=v z|_{Z_k}$. Thus $(b_k,r_k)$ gives a map $Z_k\to E$, so $v z(Z_k)\subset W$. Joint surjectivity of this covering implies $z(Z)\subset W_V$. A morphism whose image lies in an open factors uniquely through the open subscheme, by restriction of its continuous map and structure-sheaf map [def-weil-open-immersion]. This produces the inverse to step 4: uniqueness follows from step 2, and both constructions commute with restriction. Hence $h_V\times_F F'\cong h_{W_V}$ over $h_V$.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), final paragraph: every test morphism admitting a lift factors through the candidate open

proof.text: For an arbitrary $a:h_T\to F$, [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] applied to $U(-)/R(-)$ gives an fppf cover $\{\varphi_i:T_i\to T\}$ and representatives $a_i:T_i\to U$. Put $W_i=a_i^{-1}(W)$. Steps 4 and 5 identify $h_{T_i}\times_F F'$ with $h_{W_i}$. On $T_i\times_TT_j$, the two pullback open subschemes therefore represent the same subfunctor of the representable functor of the overlap: both are its pullback of $F'\to F$. Their unique isomorphism over the overlap identifies their open images, so the two pullback opens are equal.

source.place: Tag 02WU (lemma-finding-opens), local representatives and compatible inverse-image opens

proof.text: Every fppf covering $\{T_i\to T\}$ is fpqc. To check [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], flatness is already part of [def-pc-fppf-site]. For each affine open $V\subset T$, cover every $\varphi_i^{-1}(V)$ by affine opens $V_{ij}$. Their images in $V$ are open by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open] and jointly cover $V$. Since an affine scheme is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs], finitely many of these images cover $V$. These are precisely the affine opens and finite-image-cover condition in the fpqc definition. This is the short argument of Stacks Tag 022C, written out rather than introduced as another node.

By step 7, the cover of $T$ is fpqc. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-open-subscheme-fpqc-descent] to the equal-overlap opens of step 6 to obtain a unique open $W_T\subset T$ with inverse images $W_i$. Representable functors are sheaves on the fppf site: by step 7 this follows from the existence and uniqueness of descent of morphisms in [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent], with arbitrary target scheme. The local identifications $h_{W_i}\cong h_{T_i}\times_F F'$ agree on overlaps because they are identifications of subfunctors of $h_{T_i}$, using step 2. They therefore glue, by the sheaf condition, to $h_{W_T}\cong h_T\times_F F'$. More explicitly, after any $Z\to T$ pull back the covering; membership in $W_T$ and existence of a section of $F'$ above $a|_Z$ agree on that covering by steps 4 and 5, and the unique local sections glue. Thus this is a natural isomorphism on all test schemes. Since $a$ was arbitrary, the map $F'\to F$ is represented after every scheme base change by the open immersion $W_T\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], which proves both assertions.

lean.statement: theorem etale_relation_finding_opens {S : Scheme.{u}} {R U U' : Over S} (s t : R ⟶ U) [Mono (prod.lift s t)] (hrel : ∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b)) [Surjective s.left] [Flat s.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s.left] [Surjective t.left] [Flat t.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t.left] (g : U' ⟶ U) [Flat g.left] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g.left] (F : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η : coequalizer (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ⟶ F.obj) (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun k : F.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ k)) (F' : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η' : coequalizer (yoneda.map (pullback.fst (pullback.snd g s ≫ t) g ≫ pullback.fst g s)) (yoneda.map (pullback.snd (pullback.snd g s ≫ t) g)) ⟶ F'.obj) (hη' : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun k : F'.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η' ≫ k)) : ∃ α : F'.obj ⟶ F.obj, (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map (pullback.fst (pullback.snd g s ≫ t) g ≫ pullback.fst g s)) (yoneda.map (pullback.snd (pullback.snd g s ≫ t) g)) ≫ η') ≫ α = yoneda.map g ≫ (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η) ∧ AlgebraicSpace.IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsOpenImmersion p.left) α
